item.title: “Patience” & “Big Hearts” Fill Warming Centers Amid Storm
item.description: Most days, Aaron Knox goes on at least one walk meandering around the streets of downtown. In a snowstorm, though, he looks for a warm room full of “big hearts” where he can stay inside. Knox found such a room this weekend in Upon This Rock Ministries’ warming center at 645 Grand Ave. The post “Patience” & “Big Hearts” Fill Warming Centers Amid Storm appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Storm Update: 412 Ticketed, 353 Towed; Downtown Parking Ban’s Coming Back
item.description: The city ticketed a total of 412 cars and towed 353 for snow emergency violations during this long weekend's winter storm -- and plans to reinstate a parking ban for downtown Tuesday night to allow for public works to remove those remaining huge piles of snow. The post Storm Update: 412 Ticketed, 353 Towed; Downtown Parking Ban’s Coming Back appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Eviction Lawsuits Fly At New Affordable Housing Complex
item.description: One tenant of a brand new West River apartment complex saw her eviction case withdrawn Tuesday, while two of her neighbors saw their eviction cases continued to next month. Those households are just three of 22 at the 56-unit Curtis Cofield II Estates that have been hit with eviction lawsuits in recent months. The post Eviction Lawsuits Fly At New Affordable Housing Complex appeared first on New Haven Independent.
